evals.prompt: The fixture stands in for every command's output; do not run bd, gh, git, or provenance and do not publish anything. Use the rpi-review skill. Input: PR 91 and plan https://gist.github.com/example/p52. Return the findings document and your final message.
evals.expected_output: Changes requested: the Phase 1 end-to-end test is stub-only, and src/http.ts is outside the plan.
expectations: A blocking or major finding says the Phase 1 end-to-end test uses mocks and does not run the webhook handler, worker, adapter, or `test/ci/github-fixture.ts`.
A finding names `src/http.ts` as outside the plan, citing `src/http.ts:14-30` or the 'Tidy http logging' commit.
Findings are ordered most severe first.
The Phase 2 webhook test is not reported as a problem.
The review proposes no code edits of its own and does not modify the PR.
